issues.message: Admission date is missing. This is a required field for temporal validation and length of stay calculation.
issues.suggestedFix: Obtain admission date from admission H&P, registration records, or hospital information system. This is essential for validating temporal coherence (admission ≤ surgery ≤ discharge).

issues.message: Primary diagnosis is missing. This is a required field for medical validation and procedure-pathology matching.
issues.suggestedFix: Extract diagnosis from admission H&P, operative report, or discharge summary. Required for validating that procedures match pathology.

issues.message: Surgical procedures are missing. This is a required field for medical validation.
issues.suggestedFix: Extract procedures from operative report. Required for validating anatomical consistency and procedure-diagnosis matching.

issues.message: Cannot validate temporal coherence without admission date. Unable to verify chronological order: admission ≤ surgery ≤ discharge.
issues.suggestedFix: Obtain admission date to validate: (1) admission date ≤ surgery date (2025-10-10), (2) surgery date ≤ discharge date (2025-10-27), (3) calculate and verify length of stay.

issues.message: No clinical documentation provided. Cannot validate grounding, source context, or temporal attribution.
issues.suggestedFix: CRITICAL: Provide complete clinical documentation including: (1) Admission H&P, (2) Operative report, (3) Daily progress notes, (4) Discharge summary. Without source notes, cannot validate that extracted data is grounded in actual documentation.

issues.message: No sourceQuotes available for validation. Cannot verify that extracted values exist verbatim in original notes.
issues.suggestedFix: Provide source clinical notes so extraction can include verbatim quotes. Every extracted value must have a sourceQuote that exists in the original documentation.

issues.message: Admission GCS is missing. This is high-priority information for neurosurgical cases.
issues.suggestedFix: Extract from admission H&P or emergency department notes. If not explicitly documented, may need to deduce from clinical findings (e.g., 'alert and oriented x3' suggests GCS 15).

issues.message: Discharge GCS is missing. This is high-priority information for neurosurgical outcomes.
issues.suggestedFix: Extract from discharge examination or final progress note. Must use discharge-timeframe sources, NOT admission exam. If not explicit, deduce from discharge mental status documentation.

issues.message: Discharge medications are missing. This is important for medication safety validation.
issues.suggestedFix: Extract from discharge summary or discharge medication reconciliation. Required for validating doses, routes, frequencies, and contraindications.

issues.message: Discharge disposition is missing. This is important outcome information.
issues.suggestedFix: Extract from discharge summary (home, home with services, acute rehab, SNF, etc.).

issues.message: Hospital course is empty. Cannot validate temporal consistency of events, clinical trajectory, or key milestones.
issues.suggestedFix: Extract daily progress notes to document: (1) Daily events in chronological order, (2) Clinical trajectory, (3) Key milestones (surgery, extubation, ambulation, complications), (4) Gaps in documentation.

issues.message: Complications data is missing. Cannot validate medical consistency or temporal event sequences.
issues.suggestedFix: Review progress notes and discharge summary for complications. Document onset date, management, and resolution with temporal consistency.

issues.message: Functional status scores (KPS, ECOG, mRS) are all missing. Cannot validate discharge status or functional outcomes.
